constraints.description: A page with an empty title cannot contain the URL domain in its title.
constraints.rationale: domain_in_title is inverted: 1 means the domain is absent from the title. Therefore an empty title necessarily has domain_in_title equal to 1.

constraints.description: Pages with no HTTP redirects cannot have an external redirect.
constraints.rationale: nb_external_redirection counts external redirects as a subset of nb_redirection, so a zero total redirect count logically entails zero external redirects.
